answers.answer: Done is in Column.Loading.Slow: heading "Done", three placeholder cards, then the quiet text "Still loading…". The slow mark is due at 400+1000 = 1400 ms. The Done reply only comes at 400+1800 = 2200 ms.
No. At 1399 ms Done is still Loading.Fresh: heading "Done" and three placeholder cards. "Still loading…" is not shown yet.

Only SL-109 and SL-114 are shown. The labels bug and ui match SL-106, SL-109, SL-111 and SL-114. The assignees Ana Ruiz and Mika Ito then keep SL-109 (Ana) and SL-114 (Mika). The address is #/?labels=bug,ui&who=ana,mika. Labels and people are written in board order, not in click order.
SL-119 has focus. Review has no visible card, so the nearest column on the left is In progress. SL-127 is at position 8, In progress has only 2 cards, so the last card is taken.
Info notice "Added "docs" to 1 of 2 cards. A card can have at most 3 labels." with no action. SL-109 already has 3 labels, so only SL-101 gets docs.

SL-102 is at position 3 of Ready (Ready starts SL-111, SL-112, SL-102, SL-113). It carries the mark "Saving…" and keeps focus. 1 move request (moveCards) was sent. It was sent at the drop, and no notice shows yet.

The old title "Card title overflows on narrow screens" is shown again. The window title is "SL-114 Card title overflows on narrow screens · Slate". The notice is Error "Couldn't save the title of SL-114." with the action "Retry" (plus the "Dismiss" action of every error notice).

The address is the board address "#/" with no filter. The history goes back one entry; no entry is added. Focus is on the place title "Board", because the deleted card is not visible. The notice is Info "Deleted SL-114." with the action "Undo".

No notice is shown. The move notice was raised at 400 ms and ended at 8400 ms. Control+Z then does nothing, because the notice has no "Undo". SL-101 stays in Ready at position 1 (top), before SL-111. 1 move request was sent.
The address stays #/card/SL-114. Focus is on the action "Edit description". The old description "A long title pushes the labels out of the card." is shown, and no save request was sent.
"Mika Ito · 20 Nov 2026, 09:01". The reply comes at 65.2 s after the start, which is 09:01:05 and is shown to the minute. The comment text is "First note" without the outer spaces.

The comment field holds "this is Flaky" and is enabled. Focus is on the field "Add a comment". The message "Couldn't add the comment. Your text is back in the field." shows as an alert. The comment and its count are removed, and no notice is raised.

The address is the board address "#/" with no filter. The history has 2 more entries than at the start: 1 for the entered card address and 1 for the new Board entry from going up. Focus is on card SL-102.

ambiguities: PRB-052: NAV-T1.2 says "the card of that place is visible" without defining "that place". I read it as the card place just left, so focus goes to SL-102. Row 4 (place title) is the other reading.

PRB-052: NAV-T1.2 says "scroll ... not changed for a new entry", while NAV-T3.2 says the filter comes from when Board was last shown. Here the board was shown with no filter, so this does not change the answer.
PRB-018: BLK-4 only gives a count example for "X of Y cards" with 3 selected. Here the counts are 1 of 2 by analogy.
PRB-001: the slow mark time depends on reading "1000 ms after its request" as 400+1000, not 1000 from the start. FIX-L2 supports this.
